rights.attribution: MaleCNS v1.0 connectome data by FlyEM (HHMI Janelia), the University of Cambridge Department of Zoology, the MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, and Google Research.
rights.changes: Deterministically selected 128 source neurons: the two pinned sensory entries, every exact DNg02_a-g, DNp03 and DNp31 descending body, the exact vnc_motor/wm bodies those descending bodies contact directly at weight >= 5, and the maximum-bottleneck sensory-to-descending path support of at most three source edges of weight >= 10; emitted all 887 directed source edges of weight >= 5 among them; copied selected annotation and aggregate transmitter evidence; retained every edge sign as unknown; did not modify source values.

rights.redistribution_scope: This small derived JSON fixture may be committed and redistributed with this attribution, license link, citation, provenance, and change notice. The three bulk source objects remain excluded from Git.

motor_readout.definition: every exact vnc_motor/wm body that receives at least one direct source edge from a declared descending body

candidate_resolution.sensory_entry_verification: each pinned entry must independently satisfy the exact rule 'type starts with JO-E' or 'subclass campaniform sensilla entering ADMN/DMetaN'; a pinned ID is never accepted on its number alone
candidate_resolution.string_matching: case-sensitive exact except the declared JO-E prefix

fixture_closure.definition: all source edges whose endpoints are both selected bodies

path_support.definition: For each ordered (pinned sensory entry, declared descending body) pair, one simple directed path of 1..3 source edges is selected over the subgraph of source edges with weight >= 10 whose endpoints both carry an annotation row. Every body on every selected path joins the fixture. Pairs with no qualifying path are recorded and skipped, never substituted.
path_support.duplicate_directed_pair_policy: fail across every source weight row
path_support.objective: maximize the minimum raw source weight over the path
path_support.path_vertex_eligibility: every path body must have a source annotation row
path_support.tie_break: lexicographically smallest ordered source body-ID tuple among all maximum-bottleneck paths, compared across path lengths

roles.assignment: sensory for the pinned entries, descending for the declared types, motor for the resolved wing-motor readout, intermediate for every other selected body

transmitter_and_sign.policy: copy the exact aggregate transmitter row for every selected body; retain unknown edge signs

sibling_fixture_boundary: This fixture coexists with mcns-v1.0-flight-power-v1 and never replaces it; the flight-power fixture remains the authority for the full artifact boundary overlay.
transmitter_sign_boundary: No transmitter-to-sign mapping was applied; every emitted edge sign remains unknown.
